content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing, and Silverbridge does not permit retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer review. Resubmission or records alone would not cure the authorization denial, while a formal appeal is available and the clinic documentation is strong enough to support a medical-necessity argument. Patient billing is premature because the payer appeal path has not been exhausted.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
